Product

The complete structural workflow,
in one platform.

From the first node to the stamped report, every module of STRIX works on one model and one source of truth. Here is what each part does — and how it stays accurate.

Download for Windows Explore verification
Modeling

Model once, in 3D

A direct-manipulation 3D modeler for nodes, members, walls and slabs — with CAD import and automatic story generation, so the model is built in minutes, not days.

  • Nodes, beams, columns, walls and slabs — pick and edit anything in the viewport
  • Import CAD DXF drawings and auto-generate the 3D model, no re-drawing
  • Automatic story generation with section and material libraries
  • Natural-language modeling — describe the frame and STRIX drafts it
Analysis

Five analysis types, one solver

Linear static through nonlinear time-history — no scripting, with a responsive, cancellable run.

  • Linear static, modal (eigenvalue) and response-spectrum (RSA) analysis
  • Pushover (ATC-40) and nonlinear time-history for seismic performance
  • STRIX engine with custom elements — no scripts to write
  • Real-time progress with safe cancellation on large models
Design

Code-compliant design, traceable to the clause

Automatic RC and steel design to KDS and to ACI 318 / AISC 360 — with biaxial interaction, shear design and DCR checks where every number traces back to its source.

  • Automatic rebar design for beams and columns with biaxial P-M-M interaction
  • Standalone designers for beams, columns, basement walls, shear walls and footings
  • Steel member design to KBC / AISC
  • Result DNA traces each value to its governing combination and code clause
Analysis

Walls that behave correctly

Custom ASDShellQ4 shell elements eliminate the shear-locking that makes naive shells 16–19% over-stiff — wall results are cross-checked against commercial software, with the comparison published.

  • Custom ASDShellQ4 wall element — no shear locking
  • Automatic wall-structure load application
  • Precise plate analysis for wall-type buildings
  • Membrane / plate sub-types for correct out-of-plane behavior
Design

Wind and seismic, generated for you

Enter the building parameters and STRIX derives wind and seismic loads, story distributions and design response spectra to KBC/KDS — then runs a first-level seismic evaluation.

  • Wind and seismic load wizard to KBC / KDS
  • Automatic story force distribution and design response spectra
  • First-level seismic performance evaluation (m-factor method)
  • Equivalent static and response-spectrum scaling built in
Analysis

Seismic performance, rigorously

Integrated ATC-40 Pushover and nonlinear time-history analysis with FEMA backbones — and inspect hinge formation member by member.

  • ATC-40 performance-point calculation with FEMA 440 damping
  • Fiber and lumped (P-M-M) hinge models for columns, beams and walls
  • Member-by-member hinge and fiber inspectors
  • Nonlinear time-history with configurable nonlinear materials
Design

Submission-ready reports

Auto-generate editable PDF reports — section details, rebar diagrams, force tables and structural plan drawings — then refine them in a true page editor.

  • Editable PDF reports with section details and rebar diagrams
  • Auto-generated structural plan drawings with grid dimensions
  • Force and design tables, with Excel export
  • Company report templates and PDF skeleton import
Design

US codes — ACI 318-19 · AISC 360-22 · ASCE 7-22

Pick the US code family in Project Settings and STRIX runs the whole job to it — loads, RC and steel design, checks and the calculation report.

  • ASCE 7-22 seismic, wind and snow loads with load combinations
  • ACI 318-19 RC, AISC 360-22 steel and SRC design — DesignPad too
  • US units — forces, lengths, moments and stresses in kip · lb · ft · in
  • AISC v16.0 section tables, ASTM steel and ASTM rebar (#bar sizes, inches)
Modeling

STRIX AI CAD — from drawings to the model

Open the architect's DWG / DXF drawings inside STRIX, clean them up with plain-language commands, and turn them into the structural model.

  • Say “delete all hatches” — AI previews the change and applies it after you confirm
  • Familiar CAD commands and shortcuts for drawing and editing
  • Arch2Struct proposes a structural drawing draft from an architectural plan
  • Drawing to Modeling reads layers, marks, schedules and rebar to build the model — unread rebar is left blank and flagged, never guessed
Analysis

Coupling-beam stiffness, tuned automatically

For wall-type apartments, STRIX runs the repeated re-analysis of lowering coupling-beam stiffness for you and proposes a factor for every coupling beam.

  • Compare period, base shear and drift ratio before and after on one screen
  • Apply the proposed factors in one step — and undo them in one step
  • Member stiffness modifiers in addition to section stiffness modifiers
  • Step-by-step tutorial with an example apartment model
AI

Let your AI apps use STRIX — MCP server & plugins

AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor can use STRIX on this PC as a tool — and any task you do in AI Prompt can be saved as a one-click plugin.

  • MCP server — open models, run linear analysis, read results, export tables and reports
  • Every AI action is logged and undoable; deletions and large changes wait for your confirmation
  • Off by default and reachable only from this PC
  • Plugins — save as a button, share in the in-app gallery, install official plugins

Every module, AI-assisted

Natural-language modeling, an in-app KDS chatbot and pre-analysis model review run across the whole workflow — with your own API key and your data kept local.
